purpose: Versioned repair of the supplemental audit-only Medusa/Foundry full-system randomized accounting state machine for cyvlSDT v30. V1 remains immutable failed execution evidence; V2 binds the token to the real deployed Locker only after both production contracts exist. Frozen production source remains unchanged.
technicalLimitations: CurveYieldGovernanceStaking.vy is excluded from the Solidity Medusa/Foundry overlay because the accepted mixed-language runner compiles Vyper separately and crytic-compile source-map handling is not compatible with importing that Vyper target into this Solidity state machine. Its accounting lifecycle is separately exercised on real pinned Anvil in Phase 7.
This Phase-6 randomized harness is not live Phase-7 mutable-RPC simulation evidence and does not substitute for deployment-first Anvil lifecycle testing of the exact audited contracts.
